summary: Batch 1 (Five-Step Recruitment restructure) verification complete. 16/16 pytest backend cases pass. Playwright covers course overview, module routing 1..5, page titles, eyebrow 'Step N of 5', Module 2 readiness (no strategy), KnownInfo persistence across sessions, fallback inputs for empty profile, and public /recruit/process shows 5 stages. All acceptance criteria met.

issues: Uses browser default date/time picker (mm/dd/yyyy, --:--:--) instead of a styled/shadcn calendar. Pre-existing, not introduced by Batch 1.

critical_code_review_comments: course_routes.merged_course computes percent using len(modules) rather than filtering module_number<=5. If any doc with module_number 99 ever leaks into progress list, it currently cannot because merged_course only reads modules 1..5 (via loop over static list). Verified retired 99 rows do not affect /courses/recruitment/self-guided nor /courses/progress percent computation.
board_intake_routes.merge_into_recruitment_profile correctly preserves existing non-empty values (verified). No duplicate recruitment_profile docs produced.
workspace_routes.opportunity_readiness returns exactly {opportunity_saved, application_saved} — 'strategy_approved' fully removed. Publish blocks unless both true.

five_step_migration is idempotent (guarded by migrations collection with key 'five_step_recruitment_v1'); progress docs get legacy_module_number + five_step_migrated; retired module 2 rows -> 99 with retired_strategy=true; generated_materials type recruitment_strategy has module 0 (preserved).
Frontend uses uppercase CSS for '.eyebrow' — 'Step N of 5' text is present in DOM as sent-case ('Step 1 of 5') and displayed uppercase, correct.

seed_data_creation: Test members TEST_full_*/TEST_empty_*/TEST_basic_* created inside pytest fixtures (session scope) and deleted in teardown. Temporarily set module-tester recruitment_profiles.data to KnownInfo values during Playwright persistence check, then reset to {} at the end of testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Older suites in /app/backend/tests assume 6-module structure and will fail; use test_batch1_five_step_restructure.py as the fresh baseline. Run pytest with env vars REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, MONGO_URL, DB_NAME set (env is not auto-propagated). Use `-o addopts=` to bypass repo pytest.ini xdist flag which conflicts on this container.
